meaning_translation.Japanese: より高い身長を持つこと

translation.Japanese: ジョンはマイクより背が高いです。

examples.sentence: She is smarter than her brother.

translation.Hindi: वह अपने भाई से अधिक चतुर है।
translation.Japanese: 彼女は兄より賢いです。

examples.sentence: The bike is faster than the scooter.

translation.Japanese: バイクはスクーターより速いです。

meaning_translation.Japanese: お金がよりかかること

examples.sentence: The dress is more expensive than the shirt.

translation.Japanese: ドレスはシャツより高価です。

meaning_translation.Japanese: より寒い状態であること

translation.Hindi: आज कल की तुलना में ठंडा है।
translation.Japanese: 今日は昨日より寒いです。

meaning_translation.Japanese: 背が低い、または長さが短いこと

examples.sentence: This pencil is shorter than that one.

translation.Hindi: यह पेंसिल उस पेंसिल से छोटी है।
translation.Japanese: この鉛筆はあれより短いです。

meaning_translation.Japanese: より魅力的であること

examples.sentence: The sunset is more beautiful than yesterday's.

translation.Hindi: आज का सूर्यास्त कल की तुलना में अधिक सुंदर है।
translation.Japanese: 今日の夕日は昨日より美しいです。

meaning_translation.Japanese: より強い力を持つこと

examples.sentence: This movie is more interesting than the last one.

translation.Hindi: यह फिल्म पिछली से अधिक रोचक है।
translation.Japanese: この映画は前のより面白いです。

examples.sentence: My sister is younger than me.

grammar_tips.title: Comparative Adjectives: short words
grammar_tips.explanation: Add '-er' for short adjectives: tall → taller, fast → faster.

explanation_translation.Hindi: छोटे विशेषणों में '-er' जोड़ें: tall → taller, fast → faster.
explanation_translation.Japanese: 短い形容詞には '-er' を付けます: tall → taller, fast → faster.

grammar_tips.title: Comparative Adjectives: long words
grammar_tips.explanation: Use 'more' before long adjectives: beautiful → more beautiful, expensive → more expensive.

explanation_translation.Hindi: लंबे विशेषणों से पहले 'more' लगाएं: beautiful → more beautiful
explanation_translation.Japanese: 長い形容詞の前に 'more' を使います: beautiful → more beautiful

grammar_tips.title: Using 'than'
grammar_tips.explanation: We use 'than' to compare two things: She is taller than him.

explanation_translation.Hindi: दो चीजों की तुलना के लिए 'than' का उपयोग करें: She is taller than him.
explanation_translation.Japanese: 2つのものを比較するときに 'than' を使います: She is taller than him.

question_translation.Hindi: कौन सा शब्द 'अधिक लंबा' का अर्थ है?
question_translation.Japanese: 「より背が高い」という意味の単語はどれですか？

question_translation.Japanese: 「More expensive」は長い形容詞に使われます。
